records.title: Misuse of Mule Accounts for Diversion of Funds
details: (e) As per RBI’ Master Directions on Fraud Risk Management, all Commercial Banks are required to have in place a Board-approved Policy on fraud risk management, delineating roles and responsibilities of Board/Board Committees and Senior Management. Banks are also required to set-up an appropriate organisational structure for institutionalisation of fraud risk management. Banks are also required to immediately report the incidence of fraud to law enforcement agencies.

records.title: Implementation of the Green Steel Mission
details:
(b) Ministry of Steel had constituted 14 Task Forces to discuss, deliberate and
recommend upon the entire chain of decarbonisation of the steel industry.
(c) Under the National Green Hydrogen Mission of Ministry of New and Renewable
Energy (MNRE), Ministry of Steel has awarded two pilot projects to produce DRI using
100% Hydrogen in vertical shaft and one pilot project to use hydrogen in existing Blast Furnace to reduce coal/coke consumption under this Mission
